title: 국군체육부대령 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Commanding Officer and Deputy Commanding Officer) (1) The Athletic Unit shall have a Commanding Officer and a Deputy Commanding Officer.
(2) The Commanding Officer shall be a civilian military employee of Grade 2 or higher, and the Deputy Commanding Officer shall be a commissioned officer of field grade. <Amended on September 5, 2017; October 15, 2019>
(3) The Commanding Officer shall, under orders from the Minister of National Defense, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Unit and direct and supervise the members of subordinate units.
(4) The Deputy Commanding Officer shall assist the Commanding Officer and act on the Commanding Officer's behalf if the Commanding Officer is unable to perform their duties.
